TC-20/S11.title: Day and retention boundaries against the buckets (partial: back-dated records, server clock not moved)
TC-20/S11.detail: PW, local stack 25acd727, model mocked or blocked at the socket (tripwire clean). Judged 6/6, 5 record-only. Partial run: no aging helper, so each record's own timestamps were back-dated on a fresh account (seeded notes carry noteTemplate procedure-other, no billing job); the dashboards ran the lifecycle pass at 10:02 UTC and every row's bucket was compared with the stored chart. Judged and passed: (a) note 17 h -> Done with the note kept; note 19 h -> note cleared, Pending; (b) Hospital pre-round 13 h -> text cleared, Pending; (e) Nursing Home pre-round 11 h -> text kept, In Progress; 13 h -> cleared, Pending; every dashboard bucket equals the stored status. Recorded for decisions: (b) Hospital pre-round 11 h old, done 23:02 UTC the previous UTC day, is back in Pending while the chart still shows the pre-round text (the reset follows the server's UTC day, Q4); (c) seen with no note, encounter dictation 19 h / 36 h old -> dictation cleared but still Seen / In Progress with an empty chart, no rule ever moves it (Q10); (d) open tasks on a chart last processed 37 h ago are still counted on the row (UAT 3.6 36 h) - known B19 (TFA-94699, in progress: todo); (f) a resident In Today with yesterday's note: the note left and the resident is Pending, still In Today because the mark has no day (D8). Left: the same pre-rounded patient read at 05:00 and 18:00 UTC and after the server day changes, and In Today across a server day, need a movable server clock (not on main).
